commandInvocationMatching.change: Recognize complete validated invocation words with a fixed expression and query the existing live Set. Remove per-line catalog sorting, escaping, joining and dynamic RegExp construction; preserve live registry reads, ANSI handling, completion and cadence. No cache or new state.
commandInvocationMatching.helperMethod: Actual old and candidate styleKnownInvocations Sources transpiled with Bun.Transpiler; only the unchanged shared import is redirected to the same file. After 16400 equal-output cases, each variant warms up 1000 calls, then alternates 15 trials of 1000 calls with one 256-command Set and the same 92-code-unit styled result. Timing excludes transpilation and equivalence cases; CPU covers all process threads.
commandInvocationMatching.nativeConditions: Sequential fresh native Pi 0.85.0 Hosts; offline fixture Providers, 120x40 terminal, full automatic Naming/Usage, private directories and network/PID namespaces. Only the input-highlighting production helper changes across candidate/control/candidate; tests and other benchmarks are not concurrent. No profiler, preload or added delay; kernel page cache not reset.
limits: All three native runs fail unchanged Spinner and steady-input gates; this is not a no-stall result.
The native sequence does not establish whole-Host CPU, memory or latency improvement.
Warm repository-helper CPU and elapsed-time savings do not establish native Host latency, allocated bytes, GC, wakeups or all-Capability savings.
Cgroup CPU includes owned descendants. Charged memory is not peak process-tree RSS or allocated bytes; RSS and I/O are end-of-observation live-member snapshots.
First-Agent import stalls, long-Session/recovery work and full Suite acceptance remain open.

explicitSourceImports.change: Exact relative TypeScript source import paths; existing JavaScript files retained. No runtime logic, loading timing, Host loader or cache change.
explicitSourceImports.conditions: Sequential fresh native Hosts; offline fixture Providers; same 120x40 terminal, child Tool and automatic Naming/Usage; private HOME/XDG/TMPDIR and network/PID namespaces. No profiler, preload or added delay. Kernel page cache not reset.
limits: All seven samples fail unchanged liveness gates; remaining Agent blocking unresolved.
Cgroup total CPU includes the Host and owned descendants; external observer excluded.
Charged memory peak is not peak process-tree RSS or allocated bytes; RSS is one end-of-work snapshot.
I/O counters are end-of-work live-member snapshots with kernel waited-child accounting, not per-import attribution.
No allocation/GC, wakeup, long-Session, full recovery or every-Capability operation certification.

nativeReadWindows.method: Ten iterations per native preparatory Host: new CodeModeSessionLedger, cold snippets(context), same-leaf read, append one ordinary non-Ledger entry, tail read. Every result has zero snippets. performance.now duration; process.cpuUsage CPU delta. Both runs use the same temporary diagnostic.
nativeReadWindows.limits: CPU includes all threads of the seed Host during each synchronous window, not exclusive main-thread or whole-Suite CPU. Ten cache-cold Ledger instances are not ten independent cold Hosts. Baseline ran before candidate; no sample or warm-up discarded, no randomization or kernel page-cache reset. Probe adds ten ordinary seed entries; subsequent UI runs are not equivalent to uninstrumented acceptance. Diagnostic Source was removed.
nativeReadWindows.unavailableCounters: Earlier native TypeBox counter probes yielded no usable record. No native clone count or allocated-byte reduction is claimed.

coldLedgerKindDispatch.interpretation: Selected-member dispatch reduces measured cold-read elapsed time and process CPU. Three ordinary same-source runs pass frozen liveness gates. The diagnostic candidate still has a 167.931 ms Spinner frame; residual attribution, Agent gates, allocation/GC, complete resource and recovery acceptance remain open. No whole-Suite CPU reduction or ps-yon.4 closure claimed.

coldLedgerReductions.interpretation: Post-parse clones and scalar storage roundtrips removed. Cold Ledger spinner gates still fail; the same final production Source without old Ledger passes. Single samples do not establish total CPU/allocation savings or complete attribution. See the owning Markdown report for workload, retained functionality, boundaries and remaining acceptance.

resourceReader.method: Bun.spawn with inherited PTY descriptors; await child.exited, then read child.resourceUsage(). No sampling during Host work.
resourceReader.cpu: cpuTime in microseconds, including native waited-descendant accounting; wrapper/verifier and sibling fixture server are excluded.
resourceReader.maxRss: Bun-reported maxRSS bytes for the waited Host; not sum-RSS or peak process-tree RSS. Raw field largestProcessMaxRssBytes is retained as maxRssBytes below.
resourceReader.io: Filesystem operation counters, not bytes or all read/write syscalls.
resourceReader.contextSwitches: Voluntary and involuntary scheduler switches, not wakeups.
resourceReader.wall: Whole child lifetime including verifier-controlled interaction waits; not maximum UI delay or removable work.

rtkIdentityTrace.interpretation: Observed exactly one certification read and four pre-rewrite identity reads, consistent with runtime.ts and the current drift-detection contract. The ready dialog and resumed fixture added no executable reads. No extra certification demonstrated in this scenario; identity checks retained.
rtkIdentityTrace.limits: Read return values are user-buffer bytes, not physical storage I/O or total allocation. O_PATH opens are metadata-only and are not counted as content reads. Interrupted/resumed read lines are joined by trace TID. strace perturbs scheduling; these observations do not certify hashing CPU time, main-thread blocking, liveness gates, concurrent rewrites or all RTK overhead.
